summary: OccHealthCovid19EditAll is a system control that manages COVID-19 immunization status updates for students within the enrollment system. The module handles data rendering, user interaction, and submission workflow related to COVID-19 immunization statuses. It includes functionality for marking data as dirty, updating immunization records, and redirecting users based on warning messages.
purpose: To facilitate the management and update of COVID-19 immunization records for students within the enrollment system, ensuring proper tracking and administration of health details.

workflows.name: Updating COVID-19 Immunization Status
steps: Attach functions to fields and dropdowns to track changes.
Check row data for changes and mark as dirty if modified.

business_rules: Only update records marked as dirty.
Redirect user if there are warning messages after saving data.
Use dropdown lists for selecting COVID-19 status codes.
validations: Ensure data bound to controls matches expected formats and types.
Check for null sessions and cancel data source operations if not valid.
calculations: Sort data based on provided sort expressions and directions.
conditions: Check enrollment ID to determine panel visibility for saving options.
Determine if user session has messages and warnings that affect redirection.
system_behavior: Disable editing fields if read-only mode is active.
Register JavaScript functions for handling field changes asynchronously.
dependencies: User session management for context and security
exceptions: Redirect failures if warnings exist during immunization updates.
